plan.summary: Progressive base-building week. Easy Zone 2 runs Monday and Thursday with gym pairings, VO2max interval session Wednesday, strength days Tuesday and Friday, full rest Saturday, and long run Sunday targeting 20 km.

sessions.description: Easy run Zone 2 — 6 km at 6:30-7:00/km + Gym (Legs)
VO2max intervals — 4×4 min at max effort with 3 min walking recovery
Easy run Zone 2 — 6 km + Gym (Back + Biceps)
Long run — 20 km at easy pace (6:30-7:00/km)
